checkedAlternates.risk: Bone China is called china rather than porcelain.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Bone China is a translucent, vitrified type of soft-paste porcelain containing bone ash (group-4).
Unglazed red-brown terracotta (group-1) is distinct from opaque tin-glazed earthenware like faience and majolica (group-2).
